# Execution Checklist Template

## Pre-Implementation
- [ ] Scope approved
- [ ] Assumptions reviewed
- [ ] Open questions assigned
- [ ] Architecture approach selected

## Build
- [ ] Data model changes implemented
- [ ] API contract updates implemented
- [ ] Core feature behavior implemented
- [ ] Edge case handling implemented

## Quality
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] Integration tests added or updated
- [ ] Observability updates completed
- [ ] Security checks completed

## Release
- [ ] Rollout plan defined
- [ ] Backout plan defined
- [ ] Release notes drafted
- [ ] Ownership handoff completed
